set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM design renderer-neutral scientific review, using native hrf and Intaglio. Consumer: PLS Neuro W3 bd-01M1YVQ44TVRBAY11F30K7BTA1 in its own store. Existing DesignReviewGraphics exposes full design, traces and event timelines; Hrf/ResponseBasis expose native evaluation, stable basis identities/roles and exact response functionals. Public source and native issue-title inventory contain no dedicated basis preview capability.

Provide a small immutable native preview and Intaglio plot/scene API for canonical, derivative and physical FIR bases, optionally marking an explicitly requested point/window readout. Preserve native descriptor, basis IDs/roles, physical response-time axis, unnormalized evaluated values and functional/units/discretization receipt. A basis curve is a model component, not a fitted response. Display sampling must not determine exact window weights or alter model scaling. FIR discontinuities and bin intervals must be represented honestly; avoid interpolated ramps between step bins. Keep requested window separate from the basis support and do not hide unsupported functional errors.

Acceptance: JVM/Scala.js design tests, native Hrf value correspondence, independent FIR boundary/window and canonical/derivative probes, identical semantic metadata through rendered/exported plots, bounded preview sampling, malformed/non-finite/custom-basis failure behavior, clear legends and physical units at compact/normal/HiDPI dimensions. Qualify public reusable GLM consumer and native visuals before adoption. App owns controls/selection/layout; no app-specific branches or provider-local duplicate linear algebra. This is a new native capability, not completion of the overall workbench or selected-output delivery.
set.title: Design review: expose identified HRF and FIR basis preview graphics
